mechanism: Atomoxetine is a CYP2D6 substrate and hydroxychloroquine may inhibit CYP2D6, potentially increasing atomoxetine concentrations; both drugs also carry cardiac risk including QT prolongation.
action: Monitor for increased atomoxetine adverse effects (tremor, tachycardia, hypertension) and obtain baseline ECG; consider dose adjustment or alternative therapy if QT prolongation develops.
